title: First jobs with Brunis, Schoebel and Snyder at Blatt's Palm Gardens
summary: One of his first jobs was with George Brunis, Elmer Schoebel and a drummer, before they went to the Friars Inn.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Remember who else was in your earliest bands up there?
Well, one of the first jobs I had was with Georgie Brunus, Elmer Schauble, and Ralph Snyder, I think the drummer. The drummer. The rest I can't...
Was that after they'd been at the Friars Inn, they'd left there?
Well, that's before they were at the Friars Inn. This was at the Blatt's Palm Gardens on North Avenue.
When George first went up there?
